caption: The drawing depicts a beaded pouch with a gathered, ruffled top section that has vertical red stripes on a light background and a pinkish-red drawstring on each side. Below the top section, there is a decorative band featuring beadwork with a large red flower and green leaves on the right, a blue bird with green wings on the left, and a few smaller green and red accents. The lower part of the pouch displays a rural landscape scene containing three small houses in blue, yellow, and red with black or blue roofs, positioned on green grass with a red sky behind them and a green tree to the right. The bottom edge of the pouch is adorned with a row of blue beaded fringe that forms a soft curve. The background of the image is plain and light in color.
title: Bag
